messages:
alex_cs: Tidepool day0 preflight — quick paste of gaps from dryrun so we can assign owners.

maria_se: thanks alex, short list works.

alex_cs: gaps: 1) outbound rules missing for splunk collectors (hosts + CIDRs below), 2) customer requests cross-account KMS grant for their ingest role, 3) redwood-uploader role blocked by bucket policy (403s), 4) audit-forwarder lambda timed out on dryrun, 5) renewal note: customer asked about a 12% credit tied to SLO commitment.

sam_infra: share hostnames/CIDRs and I'll open netops change.

alex_cs: hosts: splunk-logs.tidepool.internal, splunk-relay-01.tidepool, splunk-upload.tidepool. CIDRs: 10.50.0.0/22, 198.51.100.128/25.

sam_infra: creating NET-8302 for egress; target deploy TOM EOD PST.

leah_eng: KMS principal? we'll add role arn with Decrypt/GenerateDataKey + DescribeKey.

alex_cs: they requested arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/tidepool-ingest and asked for DescribeKey.

leah_eng: sending a minimal policy snippet to give them.

leah_eng: ```
{"Sid":"AllowTidepoolIngest","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/tidepool-ingest"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```

maria_se: bucket role — do we have the redwood uploader ARN?

alex_cs: they expect arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-uploader and need PutObject to prefix logs/tidepool/.

sam_infra: will check bucket policy and add a tight PutObject statement if missing. ETA 24h.

alex_cs: lambda error snippet: `[2026-05-02T11:22:10Z] ERROR Runtime.TimeoutError: Lambda handler timed out after 30.00s` on rbw-audit-forwarder-prod.

leah_eng: short-term: bump to 90s + add retry. long-term: multipart S3 upload. I'll PR today.

maria_se: I'll open CS-5120, tag owners: sam_infra (egress + bucket), leah_eng (KMS + lambda), alex_cs (customer comms + renewal). tagging Sales for discount ask (do not commit).

opsbot: Ticketbot: CS-5120 created by maria_se — Tidepool day0 preflight (network/KMS/S3/audit). Priority: P2.

alex_cs: last asks: netops confirm once 198.51.100.128/25 is whitelisted, and someone draft a 30m cutover checklist for ops.

sam_infra: will confirm NET deploy in thread once done.

leah_eng: will post a 5-step cutover runbook in ~30m.

maria_se: thanks team — setting renewal_risk=moderate and updating the customer board.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: will monitor for blockers and update here.
